definition.text: Coolness; fragrance, a town in Reuben, in the territory of Moab, on the east of Jordan (Josh. 13:19); called also Shebam and Shibmah (Num. 32:3, 38). It was famous for its vines (Isa. 16:9; Jer. 48:32). It has been identified with the ruin of Sumieh, where there are rock-cut wine-presses. This fact explains the words of the prophets referred to above. It was about 5 miles east of Heshbon.

lemmas.gloss: Sebam or Sibmah, a place in Moab
Jaazer or Jazer, a place East of the Jordan
Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan
Elale or Elaleh, a place east of the Jordan
Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity, also of a mountain
